_comment: This is a template for n8n credentials. Do NOT commit actual API keys.
_instructions: Copy this file and fill in your actual credentials. The real credentials will be stored in n8n's encrypted database.

anthropic.name: Anthropic API
anthropic.notes: Create an API key at the Anthropic Console. Recommended: Set up billing with a reasonable limit.

twitter.name: Twitter OAuth2
twitter.notes: Requires Twitter Developer Account with Elevated access for posting. OAuth 2.0 with PKCE.

hypefury.name: Hypefury API
hypefury.notes: Hypefury API key from settings. May require paid plan for API access.

slack_webhook.name: Slack Webhook
slack_webhook.notes: Create incoming webhook in Slack. Used for notifications.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn OAuth2
linkedin.notes: Requires LinkedIn Developer App with w_member_social scope. Complex setup - consider manual posting initially.
